text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
"I was out with my friend, so I was a<n>little late
getting home. That's all!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
In that case, you should have said<n>what time you
were going to get<n>home. You shouldn't make Mom
worry!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I really should have kept mycool there...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What good is it if even I get worked<n>up... Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ashamed of her blunder, Ines Fujin<n>falls into a
funk.
